description: Source code for Port driver in an AUTOSAR-based embedded system, including port initialization, pin configuration, and version info functions for STM32F10x microcontrollers.

methods.name: Port_Init
methods.description: Initializes port pins based on configuration, sets default output levels, and enables remaps.

methods.name: Port_SetPinDirection
methods.description: Sets the direction (input/output) of a specific port pin.

methods.name: Port_RefreshPortDirection
methods.description: Placeholder for refreshing port directions; not implemented.

methods.name: Port_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves version information of the Port module.

methods.name: Port_SetPinMode
methods.description: Sets the mode of a port pin; mode change not supported on this CPU.
